free_tier.stated: No free tier and no free credit: the vendor's own plans data says 'Sandbox has no free tier or free credit.' The entry plan is USD 0 a month with usage paid from prepaid credit, one concurrent sandbox, three snapshots per sandbox and 100 GiB of egress a month that is refused past the allowance and never charged. Usage is USD 0.0104 per allocated vCPU-hour and USD 0.0071 per GiB-hour of memory, billed per second with a USD 0.04 minimum charge.

egress.terms: the provider card records the plans API text 'Sandbox has no free tier or free credit.' and '100 GiB egress per account each month, refused beyond it, never charged', plus USD 0.010445613415710504 per vCPU-hour and a USD 0.04 minimum charge
